summary: IO Interactive's Freedom Fighters is an alternate-history squad-command third-person shooter, originally published in 2003 and re-released digitally by IO Interactive in 2020.

entries.title: Freedom Fighters

emulation.notes: Native PC digital release is preferred.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC re-release at native settings

primary.why: The 2020 PC re-release makes IO Interactive's original 2003 game officially available digitally again, preserving the core single-player campaign and soundtrack extras. Console versions are useful historical routes, but PC is the current capture/settings path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC digital release. Record storefront/build, resolution, controller or keyboard/mouse setup, mission, difficulty, squad size/charisma state, soundtrack extras, and whether GameCube/PS2/Xbox versions were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original console routes and local multiplayer context
secondary.why: The current PC release is easiest to capture and preserve.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record storefront/build and control state; console versions are comparison routes.
